summary: Added compact mode to get_learnings. daemon.js: new pure leanLearnings(full) + isTruthy() helpers (exported); /learnings route honors ?compact=1 -> trims verdicts to {key,winner,why} (why<=200), drops recent, collapses failures to failuresCount, keeps rejected[] as-is; default payload unchanged. lib/mcp-core.js: get_learnings gains optional compact:boolean -> GET /learnings?compact=1. New test/lean-learnings.test.js (13 assertions, all pass); full unit suite 73 pass. Against the real live learnings: full 24465 chars -> compact 323 chars (98.7% smaller; recent[25] is the bulk and is dropped). Live daemon NOT restarted. Not committed.
